items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: We used to play every Saturday night down there for a lady called Miss Lillian. She's dead now, and she had a pavilion there on the bayou. We used to play for her every Saturday night.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I remember you told us once that trip when you had a job over here and then you had to get across the river and almost ran off into the river. When you came down that ramp. Yeah, that's right. That's true. I did. I think we have that on the life tape.

Uh-huh, yeah. That's when, I tell you, when we played down on the feet. We played down on the feet then. Yeah. Uh-huh. Because we had to cross a little, pull a barge, you know? You had to pull that barge with a stick, you know what I mean? Yes. And we used to play down that, down that, by a tarot road, you see? And so the man, you see, the question about it was Bill, when we knock off, the tarot we knock off, you know, it'd be late. Well the man would be at home sleeping. Then you go wake the man up, you know how…
